title: Presentations & biopsy indications
guide: The six presentations with their pattern labels (nephritic = acute GN, CKD CGN, ischemic nephropathy), the m/c asymptomatic presentation with its >500 mg + ≥3 RBC/HPF and >1 g thresholds, and the macrohematuria 40/5/1 rule.

title: Nephrotic syndrome criteria & protein thresholds
guide: Adult 1+2+3 vs children 1+2 or 3, <3 g/dl hypoalbuminemia, the retired hyperlipidemia/lipiduria criteria, nephrotic-range protein (>3500 mg/24 h adults, >50 mg/kg/day children), PCR cut-offs (3000/2000 mg/g) with its non-diagnostic caveat and the diabetes/2° FSGS/amyloidosis ACEi-ARB bracket.

title: Hypoalbuminemia, Muehrcke's line & edema theories
sec: Childhood NS: Hypoalbuminemia & Edema Theories · p757-758
guide: Urinary albumin loss with ↓ hepatic compensation, Muehrcke's white transverse nail line, underfill > overfill with the full underfill chain (oncotic loss → extravascular edema → ↓ effective volume → 2° RAS → aldosterone) and the overfill streptococcal-plasmin-ENaC/ANP-resistance path.

title: Management boxes & thrombosis risk
guide: MCD 85-90% steroid-responsive (95%) with no biopsy role, genetic FSGS → transplant, MN/IgA rare; albumin <2 g/dl thrombosis risk with the AT-III/protein C-S/platelet/fibrinogen/plasminogen mechanism list and 20% albumin 0.5 g/kg correction (FFP, egg white).

title: Edema manifestations & edema treatment
guide: Ascites (moderate-severe, tapping, pneumococcal peritonitis death), mild pleural and rare pericardial effusion (echo), salt <2 g/day + protein 1 g/kg/day, diuretics avoided unless non-collapsible IVC (pre-renal AKI) and the daily monitoring trio.

title: Steroid regimen, remission & hyperlipidemia
guide: Prednisolone 2 mg/kg/day (60 mg/m²/day) × 6 wks max 80 mg then 6-wk taper; remission 90-95% (nil/trace × 3 d, PCR <200 mg/g) vs SRNS 5-10%; hyperlipidemia resolves with steroid (no statin), its HDL-loss/LCAT/lipoprotein-lipase/VLDL pathogenesis and xanthoma/xanthelasma.

title: SRNS: biopsy, podocin & calcineurin inhibitors
guide: SRNS = proteinuria despite 4 wk full-dose steroid → biopsy (1st indication in child); genetic FSGS podocin → transplant; MCD arm → CNI DOC (6 months, max 2 yrs) with tacrolimus 0.1 mg/kg/day (neuropathy/DM/alopecia) vs cyclosporine (hirsutism/gingival hyperplasia).

title: Relapse categories: FRNS & SDNS treatment
guide: The 25/25/50 relapse split, infrequent-relapse 4-wk taper, FRNS (≥2 in 6 mo / ≥4 in 1 yr) with cyclophosphamide 2 mg/kg/day × 12 wks + steroid or levamisole, and SDNS (≥2 relapses during taper or within 14 d) treated with MMF 1200 mg/m²/day and rituximab × 4.

title: Adult nephrotic syndrome
guide: Adult triad with PCR ≥3000 mg/d, cause list (MN m/c, FSGS, MCD 15%, IgA; rare MPGN/2° amyloidosis), biopsy + rule-out-2° management, 1 mg/kg/d × 4 months steroid with SRNS m/c FSGS, and the Fabry's Maltese-cross/oval-fat-bodies note.
